Test Case ID: Scenario A - Post Moderation and Approval Workflow

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login as school_admin; 2) Open page "Bài viết" (/school-admin/posts); 3) Set bộ lọc "Trạng thái" = "Tất cả"; 4) Scroll/paginate list
Expected Results: List loads pending/approved/rejected; pagination OK; status badges đúng màu
Pre-conditions: School admin logged in; Posts exist

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Page "Bài viết"; 3) Bộ lọc "Trạng thái" = "Chờ duyệt"; 4) Verify only pending items
Expected Results: Only pending posts shown; badge "Chờ duyệt"; filter stays after refresh/pagination

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) "Bài viết" filter = Chờ duyệt; 3) Open post detail; 4) Click nút "Duyệt" (Approve), confirm dialog; 5) Observe status = "Đã duyệt"
Expected Results: Status → Approved; toast "Duyệt thành công" (hoặc tương đương); post visible to all; creator gets notification

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) "Bài viết" filter = Chờ duyệt; 3) Open post; 4) Click nút "Từ chối" (Reject); nhập "Lý do từ chối"; Confirm; 5) Observe status
Expected Results: Status → Rejected; reason saved; toast "Từ chối thành công"; post hidden from public; creator notified with reason

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Click "Tạo bài viết"; 3) Fill Title/Content/Images; set "Trạng thái" = "Đã duyệt" or "Đăng"; 4) Click "Đăng"/"Lưu"
Expected Results: Post created with status Approved; toast 201 success; appears immediately to users

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post; 3) Click "Chỉnh sửa"; 4) Update content; 5) Click "Lưu"
Expected Results: Post updated; toast 200; new content visible; edit timestamp recorded

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Select post; 3) Click "Xóa"; 4) Confirm popup
Expected Results: Post deleted; toast "Xóa thành công"; removed from list; comments/likes removed

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post with attachments; 3) View image preview/slideshow
Expected Results: Images render correctly; zoom works; no load errors

Test Case ID: Scenario B - Comment and Like Moderation

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post detail; 3) Switch to tab "Bình luận"
Expected Results: Comments list loads with author names and timestamps

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post; 3) On violating comment click "Xóa"; 4) Confirm
Expected Results: Comment removed; toast "Xóa thành công"; post updates; optional notify commenter

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post; 3) Click like count/icon to open modal "Danh sách lượt thích"
Expected Results: Modal shows users who liked; like count matches

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post; 3) Toggle "Cho phép bình luận" = Off; 4) Click "Lưu"
Expected Results: Comment form hidden/disabled; new comments blocked; old comments hidden per config
